criteria.name: Understanding of the situation
criteria.guidance: Identifies the real problem, the people involved and the constraints in the scenario, without missing key facts or inventing new ones.

criteria.name: Approach and reasoning
criteria.guidance: Gives a clear plan of action and explains why each step makes sense; weighs options and trade-offs instead of jumping to one answer.

criteria.name: Practicality
criteria.guidance: The actions are realistic for a fresher in a real workplace: concrete, in a sensible order, and they would actually resolve the situation.

criteria.name: Professionalism
criteria.guidance: Shows ownership, honesty, teamwork and respect for others; escalates or communicates with the right people at the right time.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.guidance: Well organised and easy to follow, with correct grammar and no filler.
